commitResults.messageTitle: Configure agent guidance for the student workflow
Level-0: Rename chatbot and add greeting flow
Level-1: Echo commands until the user exits
Level-2: Store tasks and list them on request
Level-3: Allow completed tasks to be unmarked

commitResults.messageBody: Include the course-provided project skill so Level-3 structural refactors can be inspected as a self-contained HTML diff.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-3: Represent tasks with a dedicated class
commitResults.messageBody: Move description and completion state into Task so marking and listing behavior stay together, satisfying A-Classes and preparing for typed task subclasses.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add repeatable console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody: Document the post-change testing rule, add a fail-fast Java 25 runner, and seed the plan with typed-task scenarios for Level 4.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-4: Add typed tasks with inheritance
commitResults.messageBody: Model todos, deadlines, and events as Task subclasses, preserve date and time text, and reject untyped fallback tasks.
Validate every command before changing task state, report malformed input through a custom checked exception, and extend the Java 25 UI plan with recovery cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-6: Delete tasks from an ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody: Move task storage to ArrayList, add validated deletion with automatic renumbering, and cover valid and invalid delete flows in the Java 25 UI plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: A-Enums: Dispatch commands by command type
commitResults.messageBody: Represent the supported console commands with a dedicated enum and route parsing through an exhaustive command-type switch without changing user-visible behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update setup guide for Orbit entry point

commitResults.messageBody: Store every task mutation in a portable relative data file and restore task type, order, details, and completion state at startup. Isolate UI cases while adding restart coverage so persistence is tested without cross-case contamination.
Retain the required feature-branch history while bringing automatic task storage into master.

Store deadline and event dates as LocalDate values, accept strict ISO input, and show readable calendar dates. Cover valid leap days, impossible dates, malformed dates, and persisted date values in the console plan.
Retain the required feature-branch history while bringing structured task dates into master.

Move command parsing, console interaction, and task-list ownership into focused collaborators while keeping Orbit as the coordinator. Preserve transactional save rollbacks and convert corrupt saved dates into user-facing storage errors.
Retain the refactoring branch while bringing the separated application responsibilities into master.

Place application, parser, storage, task, UI, and exception classes in logical packages under the existing source root. Update the console runner and setup guide to use the packaged Orbit entry point.
Retain the packaging branch while bringing the logical source layout into master.
Bring in the course-provided Gradle wrapper and build configuration, then point the application and executable JAR settings at Orbit's packaged entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for core behavior
commitResults.messageBody: Exercise parser validation, task-list indexing and restoration, and storage round trips with missing folders, mixed task types, punctuation, status, dates, and corrupt data.
Retain the testing branch while bringing comprehensive parser, task-list, and storage coverage into master.
Describe all source packages, command constants, parser construction, task state fields, and display-format overrides so Java 25 Javadoc builds without warnings.
Indent switch branches consistently, mark deliberate fallthrough paths, and use plural names for task collections without changing behavior.
Parse find commands, display ordered matches without mutation, and cover keyword searches in unit and console-flow tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Checkstyle checks for production and test code
commitResults.messageBody: Use the SE-EDU rules and fail on warnings so style regressions are caught during gradle check. Align existing test lambdas with the configured separator rule.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs for Orbit message lines
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize multi-line output without changing console responses. Exact-output tests cover single, two, and three-line messages including Unicode.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaFX chat interface for Orbit
commitResults.messageBody:
Share command execution and persistence between the new FXML conversation and the retained console interface. Use the tutorial's all-platform JavaFX dependencies and a non-Application JAR launcher.

Test response isolation, validation, persistence and save-failure rollback, plus actual packaged GUI controls, wrapping, scrolling and exit. Document running both interfaces and keep the console test runner independent of JavaFX.
